name: AVI Products India Limited
about: AVI Products India Limited distributes dental and healthcare products and equipment in India. It markets endo-motors, intra oral cameras, LED light curing machines, autoclave products, UV chambers, dental X-ray developers and fixers, composite filling materials, files for root canal treatment, and orthodontic materials, as well as dental chemicals, including etchant, root help, root cal, and desensitizer products through its e-commerce portal, and Dentaldeal.in. The company is also involved in the production of ice-creams and waffles products, such as ice cream rollies, ice cream candies/kulfis, sorbets, juices, sundaes and fusions, frosties/smoothies/milkshakes, and Belgium waffles through franchised outlets; and ice cream machines, such as single pan stir fried ice cream, small hard ice cream, tabletop soft serve ice cream, and popsicle candy machines. The company was formerly known as AVI Photochem Limited and changed its name to AVI Products India Limited in February 2016. AVI Products India Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.
